run_terminal|{"command":"# Install Maven quickly via a shell script or download it. 
# Since the user said "if maven isn't installed install it", and I have no brew/choco guaranteed, 
# I will download a portable maven zip, unzip it, and use it.
$mavenUrl = "https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.9.6/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.6-bin.zip"
$mavenZip = "$env:TEMP\maven.zip"
$mavenDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\maven"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $mavenUrl -OutFile $mavenZip
Expand-Archive -Path $mavenZip -DestinationPath $env:TEMP\maven_extracted -Force
Move-Item -Path "$env:TEMP\maven_extracted\apache-maven-3.9.6" -Destination $mavenDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# Add maven to current session path
$env:Path += ";$mavenDir\bin"
mvn -version"}|
